prompt: Create a highly realistic vertical lifestyle portrait of a young East Asian woman relaxing on a beige fabric sofa in a softly lit modern apartment living room. She is seated casually, leaning back against the sofa arm with one arm draped over the backrest and her legs angled toward the foreground, wearing an oversized white T-shirt and light blue denim shorts. The T-shirt has exactly one centered two-line handwritten-style Japanese phrase printed in gray: 日中は暑いから\n出かけたくない！. She has glossy black hair styled in exactly two long braided pigtails, wispy bangs across her forehead, fair skin, subtle natural makeup, and round thin metal eyeglasses. Her expression is calm and slightly absent-minded as she looks off to the left toward a bright window, not at the camera. Use soft summer daylight from the left, gentle shadows, shallow depth of field, and a muted neutral color palette. Background details should be blurred but recognizable: sheer white curtains and bright window on the far left, a leafy houseplant, a small framed wall picture, a simple dining table area, and a dark kitchen alcove to the right. Compose as a waist-to-knee portrait with the subject occupying most of the frame, photorealistic skin texture, realistic fabric folds, natural sofa texture, cinematic bokeh, no watermark, no extra text besides the shirt print.

promptZh: 创作一张高度写实的竖版生活肖像，展示一位年轻的东亚女性在光线柔和的现代公寓客厅里，惬意地靠在米色布艺沙发上。她姿态随性，背靠沙发扶手，一只手臂搭在靠背上，双腿向前景延伸，身穿一件宽松的白色 T 恤和浅蓝色牛仔短裤。T 恤正中央印有一行两排手写风格的日文短语，颜色为灰色：日中は暑いから\n出かけたくない！。她留着 乌黑亮丽 的长发，编成两条长长的麻花辫，额前留着轻薄的刘海；皮肤白皙，妆容自然清透，戴着圆框细金属眼镜。她神情平静，略带出神，视线望向左侧明亮的窗户，而非看向镜头。采用来自左侧柔和的夏日自然光，阴影细腻，景深较浅，色调柔和中性。背景细节模糊但清晰可辨：最左侧是白色半透明窗帘和明亮的窗户，还有一盆绿植、一幅小型墙面装饰画、简单的餐桌区域以及右侧暗色的厨房凹室。构图为腰部至膝盖的肖像，主体占据画面大部分空间，呈现写实的皮肤纹理、真实的布料褶皱、自然的沙发质感和电影级虚化效果，无水印，除 T 恤印花外无额外文字。
